title: API, Compatibility, and Migration Guide (Breaking Changes)
text: release cycle, Matrix Profile R ecosystem underwent major architectural modernization: matrixprofiler (0.1.12): Serves low-level computational engine C++17. uses RcppThread safe native parallelism (free fork conflicts POSIX dependency Intel TBB) zero-allocation data structures, linear O(N)O(N) monotonic deques O(K)O(K) algorithms. tsmp (0.5.0): Becomes pure R package (NeedsCompilation: ). removes C++ compilers, Makefiles, legacy cluster libraries (doSNOW, foreach), delegating computationally intensive operations matrixprofiler. clear separation delivers speedups hundreds times, straightforward installation operating system, eliminates memory leaks hangs multicore environments.
